clauses.clause: **No single follower is slower than the group.** While the group moves, every follower's median speed ≥ 0.95× the group median (tune); time the player stands waiting for one follower > 10 m behind ≤ 10 % of escort time (tune). PO: "let me stay with the crowd for suvivor."
clauses.note: Fresh all-level native acceptance on current main finds a binding L1 low/high counterexample: escort time6095/6090 ticks; player waits with a follower>10m behind for1003 ticks in each tier, 16.4561%/16.4696% (>10%). One violation is sufficient for the global row to FAIL. Other completed levels were also run; unavailable rows are not treated as passes. Repro: npm run qa:accept -- --level L1 --skip-browser; seed1, complete policy, both tiers; inspect G-13 stationary far-follower waiting fractions.
